question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Intriguing
solution: The correct answer is: '**Interesting'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Intriguing **means fascinating, captivating or curious. (आकर्षक, लुभावना या जिज्ञासु) • **For example**: *The mysterious old key had an intriguing design.* • Marked option **Interesting **means engaging, stimulating or thought-provoking. (आकर्षक, प्रेरक या विचारोत्तेजक) • **For example**: *The documentary about ancient civilizations was really interesting.* • So, it is clear that the most appropriate **synonym **for 'Intriguing' is 'Interesting'. • Synonyms of intriguing include alluring, enticing and captivating. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Glorifying **means praising or celebrating. (प्रशंसा करना या जश्न मनाना) • **Ravishing **means extremely beautiful or attractive. (अत्यंत सुंदर या आकर्षक) • **Stunning **means impressively beautiful or striking. (प्रभावशाली रूप से सुंदर या आकर्षक) 3e:Ta39, The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**interfere in**"
